svg.title: Tech stack as a neon sign wall
svg.desc: Neon sign wall of the tech stack in three tiers (core, strong, working knowledge), no percentages. Languages: Python, C#/.NET, JavaScript core; TypeScript, Swift, SQL strong; Java, Bash. Backend: FastAPI, Flask/Flask-RESTX, .NET Web API core; Node/Express; Django. Frontend: React, Angular core; Vue, Redux, SwiftUI. AWS core: Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, EventBridge, S3, Glue/Spark, EKS/ECS. Cloud and ops: GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure; Jenkins, Heroku. Data: MS SQL Server core; MongoDB; PostgreSQL, Oracle, Redshift, Tableau, pandas/NumPy. Testing: PyTest core; Playwright BDD, Vitest/RTL, TDD; XCTest. Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, CloudWatch, Azure App Insights. AI: Claude Code, MCP, Copilot, LangChain/Ollama/ChromaDB, Tesseract OCR.
svg.text: Brightness = depth of real use. No fake percentages.
